title: 第23章 换热水瓶第24章 考试
content_zh:
张昊宇在门口又等了十几分钟，一辆卡车开了过来停在张昊宇面前，范家强打开车门，兄弟来上车我们出发！
张昊宇上车说了一下位置，就是在城外不远，去爷爷奶奶家必须经过的一片小树林，到了地方停下车。
范大哥你们这里等一会，我先下去看看野猪送过来没有！张昊宇说完开门下车，朝小树林里走。
用意念，悄无声息的把野猪放出5头，回头朝范强喊到，范大哥野猪在这里呢！
范强招呼车厢里的4个人，兄弟们下车抬野猪，几个人把野猪全部装到卡车上！
顺利回到轧钢厂，卡车开到勤食堂门口，这时食堂门口站着十几个人，范主任和一个领导模样的中年人在说话！
卡车停下大家一下子把卡车围了起来，一群人都扒着车厢“七嘴八舌”的讨论着野猪，这时张昊宇从车上下来，小宇过来我给你介绍一下！
这是我们轧钢厂李怀德副厂长，然后又指着张昊宇，李厂长这是我们厂里六级钳工，张军的二儿子张昊宇，李厂长好！
不，不…是副厂长！小同志你好，年轻有为呀！谢谢你了！你搞到这些野猪真是帮我们厂里大忙了！
李厂长过奖了！我就是帮忙跑跑腿！今天早上范大爷找到我说需要肉。
正好我认识一些猎人，知道他们联合很多猎人，一起进山围猎野猪群，本来他们也有合作单位！只是被我截个胡而已！
李怀德哈哈一笑说截胡也是本事啊！那么多采购员没有人能一次截胡么多野猪啊！
范主任看到大家围着车厢讨论着！大声说你们赶紧把野猪抬下来称重，然后处理干净！光围着看野猪肉还吃不吃？
大家听到范主任说话！开始忙活起来，人多力量大，七手八脚的把野猪都抬下来了，李怀德和范主任都去看野猪了！
张昊宇突然看到95号院的何雨柱，何雨柱也看到了自己，何雨柱先开口，张昊宇你怎么在这里？
柱子哥，我是帮忙猎人们来送野猪的！对了柱子哥你那有卤肉调料包吗？
有啊！你要的话我晚上回家给你拿一包！
不，不用柱子哥，一会我跟范主任说一下，你用厂里的材料配置20包！
何雨柱想了想，也行！你要这么多我还真没有！
拿出中华烟给何雨柱发了一支，自己也点上一支！我先去帮忙了！好的柱子哥你去忙吧！

五头野猪一共1308斤，范主任拿着单子，交代好处理野猪的人抓紧时间处理野猪，和张昊宇来到办公室。小宇，猎人有什么要求？
范大爷，他们要全国粮票，他们有二十几个人一起，希望咱们轧钢厂能给多换点全国粮票！
还有就是咱们轧钢厂何雨柱，配制的卤肉调料包要个二十几包。其它的没有了！
全国粮票对个人来说，确实很难搞到，对于各大工厂不算什么大事！
小宇你这稍微等一会，我去找一下厂长，大量的全国粮票需要厂长签字！说完出了办公室！
content_en:
Zhang Haoyu waited at the door for another ten minutes. A truck drove over and stopped in front of Zhang Haoyu. Fan Jiaqiang opened the door, brothers came to get in the car and we set off!
Zhang Haoyu got on the car and told him the location. It was not far outside the city, in a small forest that he had to pass through to go to his grandparents' house. He stopped the car when he got there.
Brother Fan, please wait here for a while. I'll go down first to see if the wild boar has been delivered! After Zhang Haoyu finished speaking, he opened the door and got out of the car, walking towards the woods.
Using his mind, he quietly released 5 wild boars, turned around and shouted to Fan Qiang, "Brother Fan, the wild boars are here!"
Fan Qiang greeted the four people in the carriage, and the brothers got out of the car to lift the wild boars. Several people loaded all the wild boars onto the truck!
After successfully returning to the steel rolling mill, the truck drove to the entrance of the Qin Canteen. At this time, there were more than a dozen people standing at the entrance of the canteen. Director Fan was talking to a middle-aged man who looked like a leader!
When the truck stopped, everyone immediately surrounded the truck. A group of people were talking about the wild boar in the car. At this time, Zhang Haoyu got out of the car. Xiaoyu came over and I will introduce it to you!
This is Li Huaide, the deputy director of our steel rolling mill, and then he points to Zhang Haoyu, Director Li. This is the sixth-level fitter in our factory, Zhang Jun's second son Zhang Haoyu, Director Li, hello!
No, no...it's the deputy director! Hello, little comrade, you are young and promising! Thank you! You've really helped our factory a lot by getting these wild boars!
Director Li gave me the award! I'm just helping out with errands! Uncle Fan came to me this morning and said he needed meat.
I happen to know some hunters, and I know that they unite with many hunters to go into the mountains to hunt wild boar herds. It turns out that they also have cooperative units! I just cut it off!
Li Huaide laughed and said that cutting off beards is also a skill! There are so many buyers and no one can intercept so many wild boars at one time!
Director Fan saw everyone discussing around the carriage! Tell them loudly that you should quickly bring down the wild boar, weigh it, and then dispose of it! Are you going to eat wild boar meat just by looking at it?
Everyone heard Director Fan speak! They started to get busy, with more people and more strength, they managed to lift all the wild boars down. Li Huaide and Director Fan both went to see the wild boars!
Zhang Haoyu suddenly saw He Yuzhu in Courtyard No. 95, and He Yuzhu also saw him. He Yuzhu spoke first, Zhang Haoyu, why are you here?
Brother Zhuzhu, I’m here to help the hunters deliver wild boars! By the way, Brother Zhuzhu, do you have any braised pork seasoning packets?
Yes, I have! If you want it, I’ll get you a pack when I get home tonight!
No, no need, Brother Zhuzhu, I will tell Director Fan later that you use the materials in the factory to prepare 20 packs!
He Yuzhu thought for a while, that’s okay! You want so much, but I really don’t have it!
He took out Chinese cigarettes and handed one to He Yuzhu, and lit one himself! I went to help first! Okay, Brother Zhuzhu, go and get busy!
The five wild boars totaled 1,308 kilograms. Director Fan took the list and told the person who handled the wild boars to hurry up and deal with the wild boars, and came to the office with Zhang Haoyu. Xiaoyu, what do hunters want?
Uncle Fan, they want national food stamps. There are more than 20 of them, and they hope that our steel rolling mill can exchange them for more national food stamps!
There is also He Yuzhu in our steel rolling mill. The braised pork seasoning package he prepares costs more than 20 packages. Nothing else!
National food stamps are indeed difficult for individuals to obtain, but it is not a big deal for major factories!
Xiaoyu, wait a moment, I'll go find the factory director. A large number of national food stamps require the factory director's signature! After finishing speaking, I left the office!
